family_mismatch.note: mismatch activity for the 'other' family is not independently verified for PDK family 'sky130'; treat any sampled spread for it as unconfirmed.

Poly-resistor subcircuits (e.g. sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po_*) draw a per-instance AGAUSS term (res_match, rend) scaled by MC_MM_SWITCH, which any _mm-suffixed process-corner section (e.g. tt_mm) sets to 1 -- identical instances sample independent values (see docs/cli/sim.md's 'Known-good mismatch mechanisms'). Corner-level var_mult is a separate, shared term. See issue #3032.

MOS per-instance mismatch is active in any _mm-suffixed process-corner section (e.g. tt_mm) -- select that section via corners.process to sample it (see docs/cli/sim.md's 'Known-good mismatch mechanisms').
